name: aitrainer-work
description: Find paid AI training work: search 6,000+ open roles across 20+ platforms, matched to your background, with interview practice.

interface.longDescription: Find paid remote work training and evaluating AI models. aitrainer.work is a career platform for AI training work, and this app searches its job board: more than 6,000 open roles from over 20 hiring platforms, including Mercor, micro1, Outlier, Handshake AI and Turing. Describe your background to see the roles that match it, or search by keyword, field, country and minimum hourly pay. Each role shows pay, eligible countries, weekly hours and whether there is an interview, and links to its page on aitrainer.work, where you apply. Compare platforms by open roles, pay and payout speed, check market pay, and prepare for a platform's interview with practice questions for your role.
defaultPrompt: What AI training work fits my background?
Find AI training jobs that pay at least $40 an hour.
Help me prepare for an AI training platform interview.

positive.description: Matches a profession and country to open roles.
positive.prompt: I'm a registered nurse in Canada. What AI training work could I do?
positive.expected_behavior: Job cards for nursing roles open to Canada, each with pay and a View role link to aitrainer.work.

positive.description: Searches roles by skill with a minimum hourly pay.
positive.prompt: Find remote Python jobs training AI that pay at least $40 an hour.
positive.expected_behavior: Python roles at $40/hour or more, most relevant first, as job cards linking to aitrainer.work.

positive.description: Explains a platform's hiring steps and runs a mock interview.
positive.prompt: Help me prepare for the micro1 interview for a data engineer role.
positive.expected_behavior: Explains micro1's hiring steps and offers a mock interview using practice questions, one at a time.

positive.description: Compares platforms by open roles, pay and payout speed.
positive.prompt: Which AI training platforms pay fastest, and how many open roles do they have?
positive.expected_behavior: Platforms with open role counts, median hourly pay and payout speed.

positive.description: Reports market pay for AI training work.
positive.prompt: What's the typical hourly pay for AI training work right now?
positive.expected_behavior: The market median and quartiles from stated listing rates, with a link to the methodology.

negative.description: Not AI training work: a general cover letter request. No tool call expected.
negative.prompt: Write me a cover letter for a marketing manager job at Nike.

negative.description: Unrelated question. No tool call expected.
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Toronto tomorrow?

negative.description: The plugin has no account access and doesn't act on other platforms. No tool call expected; ChatGPT should say it can't do this.
negative.prompt: Log into my Outlier account and check my task queue.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: job search, profile matching, interview practice, platform comparison and pay stats.
